One sentence: this is a higher education position centered on turning biological science into courses and teaching and student assessment and that may also carry research; the core is teaching training and course development and student guidance, not only doing experiments; its U.S. wage and employment and industry data are all given in the 25-1042.00 scope for this occupation with labels at every occurrence; on the mainland China side only the 2024 education industry average is used as an explicit proxy with 'not this occupation's wages' labeled.

The work of postsecondary biological science teachers can be divided into three categories: teaching and student assessment (teach topics such as molecular biology and marine biology and botany to undergraduate or graduate students; evaluate and grade students' class work and laboratory work and papers; initiate and lead and moderate classroom discussions; prepare and administer and grade examinations; provide out-of-class tutoring for students who need extra help); course and laboratory development (plan and evaluate and revise courses and course content and course materials and teaching methods; prepare materials for laboratory activities and syllabi and assignments and handouts; guide students' laboratory work; select and purchase materials such as textbooks and laboratory equipment; maintain or repair laboratory equipment; provide students with out-of-class experiences such as field trips); and research and student guidance and academic service (conduct research in the field and publish results in journals or books or electronic media; guide students' teaching and internships and research; follow developments in the field; work with peers on teaching and research issues; write research grant proposals; review for journals; serve on committees on institutional policy and departmental affairs and academic issues; participate in admissions and registration and placement activities; advise students on academic and career direction and hold regular office hours; keep required records such as attendance and grades; compile bibliographies of specialized materials; take part in campus and community events; serve as an advisor to student clubs; provide professional consulting to government or industry; and undertake administrative duties such as department head). What the three categories share is writing course objectives and assessment bases and laboratory safety clearly, rather than teaching first and adding the materials afterwards.

The current task set has 28 items: 22 core, 5 supplemental and 1 new task; 27 items have importance scores and writing letters of recommendation is Not available. There are 41 work activities, 31 detailed activities and 57 context items; the ratings are not proof that every person carries out all tasks.

entries: Course objectives and instructional design | Give teaching a basis | Write the course objectives and teaching content and assessment methods clearly according to learners' foundations and disciplinary requirements, and state the laboratory safety and academic integrity boundaries in advance.

Teaching and classroom facilitation | Make learning happen | Teach according to the course plan and facilitate discussion and demonstrate standard practice, adjust the teaching pace according to student feedback, and do not omit safety and standards requirements.

Laboratory teaching and safety | Make operations controllable | Complete hazard identification and risk assessment and control and emergency response preparation according to the school's laboratory safety system, and prepare laboratory materials and guide student experiments within the authorized scope.

Assessment and feedback | Make results testable | Assess class work and laboratory work and papers and examinations according to the grading standards, give reviewable feedback, record grades and attendance, and handle academic integrity issues according to the system.

Student guidance and academic service | Make growth supportable | Provide advice on academic and career direction and hold office hours, guide teaching and internships and research, and take on academic service work such as departmental committees and admissions and registration and placement.

Compliance and escalation | Stop risks early | When student safety or hazards or student personal information and academic integrity are involved or something is beyond your authorization, report and hand over according to the authorization chain and do not handle it on your own.

The basis for comparison is the official occupation description of O*NET 25-1042.00 and the list of related occupations on the O*NET page (Agricultural Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary; Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, and Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary; Chemistry Teachers, Postsecondary; Environmental Science Teachers, Postsecondary; Health Specialties Teachers, Postsecondary; Mathematical Science Teachers, Postsecondary; Molecular and Cellular Biologists; Physics Teachers, Postsecondary; Teaching Assistants, Postsecondary; Biological Technicians; Geneticists; Bioinformatics Scientists; Biologists; Biochemists and Biophysicists and others), as well as the adjacent occupation relationships noted in the routing materials; an adjacent relationship only indicates proximity of duties and does not mean that qualifications, authorization or positions are interchangeable.

The table below compares postsecondary biological science teachers with five adjacent directions on the same set of dimensions: occupational direction, core work and outputs, key differences, and which choice suits each preference.

Biochemists and biophysicists take experimental and mechanism research as their main duty and produce mainly experimental data and papers, and do not take on systematic course teaching and student assessment; postsecondary biological science teachers produce mainly per-course teaching and assessment and student development.

If you would rather do experimental and mechanism research and not take on teaching, compare biochemists and biophysicists first; if you are willing to explain biological science clearly and assess student growth, then this occupation suits you.

If you would rather do experimental research at the cellular and molecular level, compare molecular and cellular biologists first; if you are willing to design and teach such courses, then this occupation suits you.

entries.answer: Teach biological science courses, including both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who combine teaching with research: teach topics such as molecular biology and marine biology and botany to undergraduate or graduate students; evaluate and grade students' class work and laboratory work and papers; plan and evaluate and revise courses and course content and course materials and teaching methods; prepare materials for laboratory activities and syllabi and assignments and handouts; initiate and lead and moderate classroom discussions; guide students' laboratory work; guide students' teaching and internships and research; tutor students who need help outside class; advise on academic and career direction and hold regular office hours; keep records such as attendance and grades; prepare and administer and grade examinations; follow developments in the field by reading literature and exchanging with peers and attending academic conferences; conduct research in the field and publish results; work with peers; select and purchase textbooks and laboratory equipment; serve on committees; provide out-of-class experiences such as field trips; write research grant proposals; review for journals; participate in admissions and registration and placement activities; maintain or repair laboratory equipment; undertake administrative duties; compile bibliographies; take part in campus and community events; serve as an advisor to student clubs; provide professional consulting; and write letters of recommendation for students.

entries.answer: Key risks include crossing laboratory teaching safety and hazard management boundaries, compliance risks for student personal information and grades, academic integrity and assessment disputes, generative AI output being treated as teaching content or an assessment basis, long screen hours and standing while teaching and workload, and crossing teacher qualification and teaching and funding authorization boundaries; the control approach is to work first within the authorized teaching and laboratory and academic integrity scope and carry out risk identification, handle matters involving hazards and student information according to procedure and retain records, truthfully record course materials and assessment bases and safety records, issue assessments and advice within the authorized scope, and stop and escalate when beyond authorization or when anomalies are found.
entries.question: What risk does this job most need to note in advance?

entries.answer: Look at reviewable output: whether you can organize subject content into targeted courses and design consistent assessment, whether you can organize classes and laboratories according to procedure and record, and whether you can stop and review and report when safety hazards or student safety incidents or assessment disputes arise. An interest code of SI and skill and knowledge scores only indicate that the direction is close and cannot replace this practical evidence.

entries.answer: Generative AI can serve as a tool for course design and material drafting and research support and may change lesson material and handout drafting, question bank and examination paper drafts, literature and material search and compilation, and grade sheet and feedback draft organization; but the setting of course objectives, classroom facilitation, assessment and academic integrity judgments, laboratory teaching safety and hazard management, and student guidance responsibility are still borne by people. The UNESCO Guidance for Generative AI in Education and Research suggests assessing pedagogical appropriateness and ethical impact before using generative AI in teaching.
entries.question: Which tasks will AI change?

entries.answer: The setting of course objectives, assessment and academic integrity judgments, laboratory teaching safety plans and hazard management, and disposition decisions involving student personal information and research ethics and the use of funds must be borne by the person themselves and authorized personnel in accordance with the applicable jurisdiction and school systems; generated content can only serve as a rollback-able and reviewable assistive stage.

entries.answer: Check in six categories: education (the O*NET education composition is 48% doctoral degree, 38% post-doctoral training, 12% master's degree); vocational training and continuing education (the training page shows 6,758 training programs registered nationwide); industry certification (the certification page shows 2 national certifications); teacher qualification recognition (the Regulations on Teacher Qualifications establish the teacher qualification system, and the higher education teacher qualification is a separate category recognized by the competent education administrative department or an entrusted higher education institution); laboratory safety training and assessment (the Laboratory Safety Standards for Higher Education Institutions require receiving training first and passing assessment before carrying out experimental operations); and institutional teaching and assessment and laboratory teaching and funding and data handling authorization. hero.quick_answer: Postsecondary biological science teachers teach biological science courses, including both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who combine teaching with research: teach topics such as molecular biology and marine biology and botany to undergraduate or graduate students; evaluate and grade students' class work and laboratory work and papers; plan and evaluate and revise courses and course content and course materials and teaching methods; prepare materials for laboratory activities and syllabi and assignments and handouts; initiate and lead and moderate classroom discussions; guide students' laboratory work; guide students' teaching and internships and research; tutor students who need help outside class; advise on academic and career direction and hold regular office hours; keep records such as attendance and grades; prepare and administer and grade examinations; follow developments in the field and conduct research and publish results; work with peers on teaching and research issues; select and purchase textbooks and laboratory equipment; serve on committees and academic service; write research grant proposals and review for journals; maintain or repair laboratory equipment; and write letters of recommendation for students; their work does not equal the institution's teacher qualification recognition or teaching and assessment and funding authorization, nor does it replace the regulatory requirements of the applicable jurisdiction and competent authorities and school systems for teacher qualifications and laboratory safety and academic integrity and student personal information management, and it stops and escalates when laboratory teaching involves unassessed hazards, when situations requiring specific approval such as human-subject research or data export are involved, or when student safety incidents or assessment disputes or situations beyond one's authorization are found.

subject.summary: Postsecondary biological science teachers teach biological science courses, including both teaching-focused teachers and teachers who combine teaching with research: teach topics such as molecular biology and marine biology and botany to undergraduate or graduate students, evaluate and grade students' class work and laboratory work and papers, plan and evaluate and revise courses and course content and course materials and teaching methods, prepare materials for laboratory activities and syllabi and assignments and handouts, guide students' laboratory work and teaching and internships and research, conduct research in their field and publish results, and advise students on academic and career direction and maintain teaching records. On the mainland China side, according to the evidence standard (industry_proxy, resolution 'use the education industry average as an explicit proxy') only the 2024 education industry average is used as an explicit proxy with 'not this occupation's wages' labeled at every occurrence, and the industry average is not written as an occupational median or starting salary; teacher qualifications and laboratory teaching in mainland China are subject to the Regulations on Teacher Qualifications and the Laboratory Safety Standards for Higher Education Institutions and other provisions.
